decisions.statement: The port ComfyUI answers on is what `ZIMAGE_PORT` names.
The host data directory is what `ZIMAGE_HOME` names.
Every word this takes is a flag or a flag's value.
The flags this command takes are the flags mflux-generate takes.
A model nothing registers is refused naming the models there are.
The steps and the guidance nothing named come off the named model's own profile.
A base model said here is passed over and the render goes by the model said.
A checkpoint is staged under a name the path that checkpoint came from is hashed into.
A checkpoint already staged at the size that checkpoint has is staged no second time.
A seed nothing named is drawn.
The image is written where the caller named that image and nowhere else.
One workload runs on the GPU at a time.
Nothing here starts the container or provisions the weights.
The copy is named as soon as that copy lands, and the staging again once that copy is moved.
A render that threw part way names those files in its refusal.
A render that refused part way says what it had passed over by then.
The copying and the moving are handed in.

definition: the command rendering one image off a registered checkpoint
